source: RuneScape 3 cache data by mejrs / RuneScape Wiki maps project (github.com/mejrs/data_rs3: npcids, locations, location_configs, map_labels, map_label_locations, transport_data, teleport_data, clue_locations); Agility shortcut levels from runescape.wiki/w/Shortcuts; optional wiki tables from scripts/rs3-wiki/ (slayer masters, drops, quests, shops)
notes: Map squares (cx*256+cy). Old-style dungeons (squares y 136-169) folded onto the surface square above. n = in-game world-map label in (or near) the chunk; m/p/o/s = NPC/object spawns; c = clue scroll step locations per tier (also overlays.Clues); connect = cache transport links (fairy rings, spirit trees, gliders, balloons, carpets, charters, obelisks, lodestones, canoes, boats, dungeon entrances, cross-chunk stairs/ladders, agility shortcuts) with named network/dungeon nodes. Wiki tables merged when present: slayerMasters yes, drops yes, quests yes, shop stock yes. Not covered (no RS3 source): achievement diaries (d), ground item spawns (i), skillItems, taskUnlocks, questSections, impling/crime/star overlays (implings only spawn in Puro-Puro in the cache).
